name: partner-center-onboarding
description: Self-serve Partner Center onboarding with guidance-only registration, tenant association, account verification, publish-path, and REO/MPO/CSP/Japan-tax triage. Includes four decision-flow images, a JP tax cheatsheet, and the internal account-verification specialist. A separate, optional marketplace-publishing skill uses the official Marketplace Ingestion MCP for publisher-side schema discovery, scoped reads, payload validation, and individually approved changes. Human sign-in in the seller-associated tenant and Marketplace submission API access are required; missing access leaves publishing blocked without widening account-guidance permissions. Portable Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot CLI and Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork; live Cowork connector authentication is not yet verified.
